# Roles Responsibility Matrix (RACI) Template

Use this template to map who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, or Informed for key activities.

| Activity / Phase | Business Analyst | Project Manager | Product Owner | Dev Team | QA Lead | DevOps | Customer Success |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Requirements gathering | R | A | C | I | C | I | I |
| Solution design | C | A | C | R | C | C | I |
| Build / Implementation | I | A | I | R | C | C | I |
| Test / Validation | C | A | C | C | R | C | I |
| Release / Deployment | I | A | I | C | R | R | I |
| Post-release support | I | A | I | C | C | R | R |

Notes:
- R = Responsible (does the work)
- A = Accountable (owns the outcome)
- C = Consulted (two-way communication)
- I = Informed (one-way communication)

Copy this file into a project-specific document and adapt the matrix for your team's structure.
